svg.text: A sandbar a half-kilometre long: town at the root, docks on the sheltered sound, beaches on the sea side, cliffs and the lighthouse at the tip.

g.text: cranes · dry dock · coal bunkers · Ned's barge

svg.text: Linear: one road and one rail out along the spit, each district
a step further from town and a little more Hollow. Side
trails dip to the sea side and come back. The Neck is a
choke; the Lily rides at anchor ahead the whole walk out.
the station at the root of the spit
in town, then outward: docks, beaches
the rigged game on Ned's card barge
from the pier under the lighthouse
by the coaling port, low and quiet
coaling port: in with the coal
